summary.en: Runs in VR (title scene, 54.1 fps); playtest pending

known_issues.summary: Hull and domain shaders are not translated (Unity goes on without them)
Not played past the title scene yet

notes: 2026-10-15: level controls (20261015T011747Z-thelab-title, VXRT_NO_WINE=1); playable needs a playtest (tools/vxrt_playtest.py 450390).

2026-10-17: on the ARM64 runtime (VXRT_ARM64=1, the program translated by VXRuntime's own translator): the title scenario runs 150 s at 52.7-56.4 fps (Rosetta 59.4-59.6, alternating runs 20261017T0854-0901), after b3b2368 and eff0df3; one run of two ended early, and Mono reports its collation tables broken there (VXRuntime/TRANSLATOR.md).

2026-10-22: the game's own controller bindings load. Before, The Lab's first OpenVR connection (closed at its VR_Shutdown during start-up) stayed open for SteamVR's server, which learns of a gone client from PeekNamedPipe; at the next VR_Init the server dropped it as a dead process and kept the app on legacy input, so its actions.json never applied and every action read failed (InvalidHandle, 29,100-65,719 per run; issue #2 with a Quest 3 too). PeekNamedPipe now fails with BROKEN_PIPE there: 20261022T044245Z (bindings_*.json from StreamingAssets loaded, 0 InvalidHandle, 54 fps); Alyx unchanged (20261022T044359Z-alyx-menu, 60 fps). Buttons in the headset not checked yet.

2026-10-23: on the ARM64 runtime the collation message is gone (0 managed exceptions, 4323 collation lines per run before) and 3 title runs in a row ran the whole 150 s (20261023T085322Z, T090031Z, T090321Z, VXRT_ARM64=1): the translator's engine linked a jump site to the wrong block after a changed (Mono JIT) block, so Mono's loops went to unrelated code (be86f36, VXRuntime/TRANSLATOR.md). fps not measured that day: the Mac was loaded (load average 150-270, a visionOS Simulator), and both runtimes fell to 0-5 fps about 35 s in (Rosetta too: 20261023T085625Z, T093453Z).

2026-10-24: on the ARM64 runtime about a quarter of the title runs end at the title scene when Unity's allocator faults at UnityPlayer.dll+0xdfa4ce (3 of 8 runs 20261023T1534-1549 with the RBP-ordering fix, never under Rosetta); the runs that do not crash, and Rosetta's since 2026-10-22 (20261022T224326Z, 20261023T121554Z, T121836Z), drop to 5-9 fps at that moment instead of staying at 56-60. Fixed meanwhile: SMC retry for ever on freed memory, RBP-based accesses not in x86's order (VXRuntime/TRANSLATOR.md).
